import os, glob

# Check the only project-looking directory for legitimately uploaded HR data

# Search that directory + whole tree for HR artifact patterns (data files only)

hr_patterns = ["*offer*", "*agreement*", "*background*", "*bgc*", "*document*", "*artifact*", "*doc*.csv", "*doc*.json"]
hits = []
for pat in hr_patterns:
    hits += glob.glob(f"**/{pat}", recursive=True)
hits = sorted(set(h for h in hits if not h.startswith("./.ipython") and not h.startswith("./.cache")))
print(hits if hits else "  No HR artifact data files found anywhere in the accessible tree.")

# Final check: is there ANY tabular HR-ish data (employees, docs) available?
print("\n=== Any tabular data files (excluding runtime) ===")
tables = []
for ext in ("*.csv", "*.json", "*.parquet", "*.xlsx"):
    for f in glob.glob(f"**/{ext}", recursive=True):
        if not any(s in f for s in (".ipython", ".cache", ".config")):
            tables.append(f)
print(tables if tables else "  None found.")
